description: Compare types of cleaning services in Finland, from home and move-out cleaning to deep cleaning, window cleaning and office cleaning.
intro: Whether you need regular cleaning, a one-time visit or a thorough clean, choosing the right service starts with understanding what is included.

sections.text: Regular home cleaning helps keep everyday spaces tidy. Agree in advance which rooms and surfaces are included and how often the cleaner should visit.

sections.heading: Move-out and deep cleaning

sections.heading: Window and office cleaning

faqs.q: How do I choose the right cleaning service?

title: Home Cleaning in Finland – Find a Cleaner
description: Need home cleaning in Finland? Compare regular and one-off cleaning, what a visit may include and what to ask before booking.
h1: Home cleaning that fits your routine
intro: Home cleaning can be a regular service or an occasional visit. Describing the work clearly makes it easier to compare providers and avoid surprises.

sections.heading: What does home cleaning usually include?
sections.text: Common tasks include dusting, vacuuming, mopping floors and cleaning kitchen and bathroom surfaces. The exact tasks and duration depend on the agreement.

sections.heading: Regular cleaning or a one-off visit?
sections.text: Regular cleaning helps maintain a routine. A one-time service may be more suitable before guests arrive or when a home needs extra attention.

sections.heading: Before you book
sections.text: Share the property size, information about pets, delicate surfaces and your preferred cleaning products. Check who brings supplies and how extras are priced.

sections.heading: Agree on what home cleaning includes
sections.text: A visit may include vacuuming, mopping, dusting and cleaning kitchen and bathroom surfaces. Oven cleaning, windows, materials and travel charges may require separate agreement, so confirm the quote before booking.

sections.heading: Find home cleaners nearby
sections.text: Enter the cleaning location and property size in the HaeSiivooja Android app. Compare local providers and agree the work duration. Registration is free. Customers pay a €12.50 service fee when booking, while cleaning work is paid separately.

faqs.q: How often should I arrange home cleaning?
faqs.a: It depends on the household and your preferences. Weekly, fortnightly and occasional cleaning are common options.

faqs.q: Is home cleaning eligible for a household tax deduction?
faqs.a: It may be, subject to current Finnish tax rules and provider eligibility. Check the Finnish Tax Administration's guidance before ordering.

title: Move-Out Cleaning in Finland – Prepare for Handover
description: Planning a move? Learn what move-out cleaning may cover, when to arrange it and how to compare quotes before handing over the keys.
h1: Move-out cleaning before handing over the keys
intro: A thorough move-out clean helps leave a property ready for its next occupants. The required tasks depend on its condition and your agreement with the landlord or buyer.

sections.heading: What should move-out cleaning cover?
sections.text: Review floors, room surfaces, kitchen cupboards, agreed appliance interiors, the bathroom and any storage areas. Check the terms of your tenancy or sale before booking.

sections.heading: Plan around moving day
sections.text: Whenever possible, schedule cleaning after the property is empty. Allow enough time to check the result before the keys are returned.

sections.heading: Request an itemised quote
sections.text: Ask whether oven and fridge interiors, windows, balconies and storage areas are included. Confirm charges for extras and any time limits in writing.

sections.heading: Use a property handover checklist
sections.text: Check which areas must be cleaned before giving back the keys. Agree separately about cupboard interiors, appliances, windows, balconies, saunas and storage spaces.

sections.heading: Plan the timing
sections.text: Arrange cleaning after the property has been emptied and before handover. Tell the provider about access arrangements and any deadlines.

faqs.q: Is window cleaning included in move-out cleaning?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Confirm it directly in the quote or cleaning agreement.

faqs.q: Who is responsible for the cleaning quality?
faqs.a: The cleaning provider is responsible for performing the agreed work under its terms and applicable law.

title: Deep Cleaning in Finland – Plan a Thorough Clean
description: Find out what deep cleaning may include, how it differs from regular home cleaning and what to clarify when comparing services.
intro: Deep cleaning focuses on areas and surfaces that need more attention than a standard cleaning visit. Define the work before you request a price.

sections.heading: What may be included?
sections.text: Depending on the agreement, deep cleaning can cover stubborn dirt, inside cupboards and harder-to-reach surfaces. These tasks are not automatically included in every package.

sections.heading: How should I prepare?
sections.text: List the most important tasks and describe the property's condition. This helps a provider estimate the time, supplies and equipment needed.

sections.heading: When a more thorough clean makes sense
sections.text: Deep cleaning helps with areas that ordinary maintenance leaves behind, such as kitchen grease, bathroom limescale, skirting boards, behind furniture or neglected surfaces.

sections.heading: Agree the scope and estimate
sections.text: Describe the current condition, materials and specific tasks so the professional can estimate duration, supplies and the final cost.

faqs.q: What is the difference between deep cleaning and regular cleaning?
faqs.a: Regular cleaning maintains the home over time. Deep cleaning usually means a more thorough, specifically defined visit.

title: Window Cleaning – Compare Quotes in Finland
description: Understand what affects window cleaning prices, including window size, height, access and the surfaces covered by your quote.
h1: Window cleaning: agree on the details first
intro: The number, structure and accessibility of windows all affect the work. A clear quote should separate included tasks from optional extras.

sections.heading: What information should I share?
sections.text: Count the windows or take photos. Describe double glazing, balcony glazing, high windows and any access or safety concerns.

sections.heading: What does the service include?
sections.text: Check whether the quote covers inside and outside panes, inner panes, frames and sills. Never assume every surface is included in the base price.

sections.heading: Window types and accessibility affect quotes
sections.text: Tell the cleaner the number of windows, their sizes, whether they open, the floor level and any balcony glazing. Check whether inside and outside panes, frames and blinds are included.

sections.heading: Prioritize safe access
sections.text: High or difficult-to-reach windows may require special equipment. The professional should decide how to perform the job safely before quoting.

faqs.q: Can windows be cleaned in winter?
faqs.a: This depends on the weather, window design and safe access. Confirm the suitable time with the provider.

title: Office Cleaning in Finland – Plan a Cleaning Service
description: Explore how to plan office cleaning, from floor area and cleaning frequency to access arrangements, hygiene needs and comparing providers.
intro: Well-planned cleaning supports day-to-day work. Clear requirements for the space, usage and cleaning frequency make provider quotes easier to compare.

sections.heading: Describe your space and priorities
sections.text: Share floor area, room types, occupancy, operating hours and any requirements for washrooms, kitchens, security or access.

sections.heading: Compare frequency and service scope
sections.text: Separate daily or weekly tasks from occasional work. Agree on supplies, waste handling, quality checks and how exceptional situations are managed.

sections.heading: Describe the premises
sections.text: Specify floor area, workstations, kitchens, toilets, meeting rooms and desired cleaning frequency. Building access and working hours influence the plan.

sections.heading: Confirm access and responsibilities
sections.text: Agree about keys, cleaning products, restricted areas and appropriate insurance, then compare clearly itemized quotes from providers serving your location.

faqs.q: Should office cleaning have a written contract?
faqs.a: A written contract specifying tasks, frequency and responsibilities helps avoid misunderstandings.

title: Our History – Hae Siivooja Cleaning Marketplace
description: The HaeSiivooja story: Finnish cleaning marketplace created by mobile developer Oleg Lihvoinen and UX/UI designer Viktoriya Lihvoinen.
h1: Our history: connecting cleaners and customers
intro: It all started with a simple idea: make finding trusted nearby cleaning help easier, while creating more opportunities for people working in cleaning.

sections.heading: It started with a simple idea
sections.text: Many people in Finland wanted an easier way to find a reliable cleaner near their homes. At the same time, skilled cleaning professionals were looking for customers and work opportunities. We wanted to connect those two groups through a convenient digital service.

sections.heading: Building a transparent Finnish marketplace
sections.text: What began as a small idea grew into HaeSiivooja, a digital and sustainable marketplace where customers can discover local cleaning help and professionals can present their services. Our goal is to strengthen trust, opportunity and community through clearer choices and easier connections.

sections.heading: The two people behind HaeSiivooja
sections.text: The app was developed by a two-person team: Oleg Lihvoinen and Viktoriya Lihvoinen. Oleg is the mobile developer responsible for the application's technical implementation. Viktoriya designed its user experience, user interface, visuals and official website at haesiivooja.fi.

sections.heading: What customers and cleaners can do
sections.text: Customers search by the location where cleaning is needed and can book with a €12.50 service fee; registration is free. Cleaning professionals can create a profile, showcase their skills and connect with potential customers. The actual cleaning service is a separate paid job agreed with the provider.

sections.heading: Our journey continues in open testing
sections.text: HaeSiivooja is currently in open testing on Google Play. We continue improving the Android app based on real use and feedback, with the goal of making finding and booking cleaning services easier and more transparent across Finland.

title: Privacy Policy – Hae Siivooja
description: How the Hae Siivooja app and website process account, booking, location and other personal data.
intro: Last updated 1 November 2026. This policy covers the Hae Siivooja app and website.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.text: The data controller for the HaeSiivooja mobile application is HaeSiivooja Oy, Finland, as identified in the Google Play developer listing. For access, correction, deletion or other privacy requests, contact info@haesiivooja.fi. The application was created by Oleg Lihvoinen and Viktoriya Lihvoinen.

sections.heading: 2. Data processed
sections.text: Depending on use, data may include name, email, phone number, cleaning address, account details, authentication information, bookings, reviews, messages, technical usage information and location needed to find nearby cleaners. If payment functionality is provided, transaction details may be processed; card data handling depends on the payment provider.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes
sections.text: We use data for accounts, matching customers and cleaning professionals, arranging bookings, support, applicable payments or billing, security, improving the service and legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Legal grounds
sections.text: Data processing may rely on a contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest or consent, depending on the activity.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing
sections.text: Relevant details may be shared with the selected cleaning provider for a booking, and with essential technical or payment processors as applicable. Personal data is not sold. Disclosure may be required by law.

sections.heading: 6. Retention
sections.text: Data is kept for as long as necessary for the service or legal obligations. Some accounting or transaction records may be retained after an account is deleted where required by law.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.text: You may request access, correction or deletion and exercise applicable rights to restriction, objection, portability or withdrawal of consent. You may complain to the Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman.

sections.heading: 8. Security
sections.text: Appropriate technical and organizational measures are used to safeguard personal information.

sections.heading: 9. Account deletion
sections.text: Request deletion at info@haesiivooja.fi using the account email address. Do not send passwords or payment-card data. Identity verification and legal retention requirements may apply.

sections.heading: 10. Updates and contact
sections.text: Updates are published here. Ask info@haesiivooja.fi for details of processors, cookies or any international transfers that apply.
